title: Frog wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='18' ry='13' fill='#7ED957'/>

  <rect x='78' y='25' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3B2A6E'/>

  <path d='M36 52 Q50 62 64 52' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='2' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='42' r='2' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='45' r='4' fill='#F0A8C8'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='45' r='4' fill='#F0A8C8'/>

  <circle cx='44' cy='68' r='3' fill='#C5F0A0'/>
